block_translation.reason: PTE.offset returns the descriptor field as a byte address. recurse_level reports the virtual span separately and does not add those low bits to the output. iotranslate adds only an in-page start_off and does not stop when TYPE is 0. output + (virtual & (span-1)) is not implemented by either helper, so translate does not return pa for a block.

other_generation_geometry.source: m1n1 proxyclient/m1n1/hw/uat.py when Ver.check('G >= G15') is true
other_generation_geometry.note: No acquired output width is bound to this branch. The 48-bit descriptor field is not an output limit, and this geometry is not an accepted format.

not_adopted: Block translation. The pinned helpers do not add a span offset to a block output, so revision 002 refuses it instead of returning the block base as pa.
The m1n1 G >= G15 level geometry. It is recorded above and is not executable. Revision 001 accepted it with the 48-bit descriptor field as a stand-in output width.
m1n1 access_gpu and access_fw tables. The codec keeps the raw AP, UXN, PXN, and OS fields.
The T8122 42-bit DMA-mask comment in driver.rs.
G14 and G14X, which share level-0 bit 39 in m1n1 and are not given T8103's 40-bit output limit.
integrations/puredarwin/m1-dart was not modified. Astra owns that codec.

Register64 packs an inclusive msb,lsb field into a little-endian 64-bit word. The codec reimplements that packing; it does not import this module.
Version matrix G13, G14, G14X, G15, G15X. G >= G15 is the only level-0 width change.
